reason: Structured feedback is required during reviews and refinement loops, not every conversation.
Fallback routing belongs to agent dispatch and orchestration; concrete orchestration entry points carry it.
Code structure is scoped to source reads/writes and code-producing or reviewing artifacts.
Generation thresholds activate on source files or code-producing agent/workflow invocation.

Auto-reply safety applies to autonomous conversation orchestration.
Iteration retention and selection apply to refinement loops and missions.
CRITICAL universal prohibition on fabricated citations and unsupported claims applies across all roles; retain the ADR kernel default.
Environment configuration is scoped to implementation and deployment design.
Agent interface contracts belong to agent authoring and conversation orchestration.
Panel sizing is an ensemble-review decision, not a universal startup obligation.
Process lifecycle requirements belong to runtime implementation and deployment; enforcement is MEDIUM despite legacy severity HIGH metadata.
Test execution and debug memory apply to code generation, implementation loops and test agents.
The ADR binds the detailed failure taxonomy to generation, recovery and validation artifacts; universal integrity guards remain kernel.
Few-shot coverage and definition size are agent-authoring responsibilities.
SDLC phase transitions and critical checkpoints have explicit scoped gate entry points; routine tasks do not require gates.
Human collaboration patterns belong to artifact review, draft generation and gated loops.
Gate presentation is activated by workflows and agents that present human checkpoints.
Directory index generation belongs to indexing skills and the context librarian.
